inconsistencies: #34533 and #36330 are competing fixes for the same defect (wallet rebroadcast leaking identity under -privatebroadcast): one resubmits via private broadcast, the other suppresses resubmission entirely. An approach decision is needed before either is reviewed in detail; #36398 (don't rebroadcast foreign transactions at all) is the broadest fix in this cluster and should be reviewed first, with #36482 and #36380/#36481 as refinements on top.

Dependency chain, review in order: #33033 (SQLite statement RAII) → #33034 (transactions in their own table) → #27865 (no-longer-spendable TXO tracking, the 500x payoff). #33034 also depends on #32895.
Dependency chain, review in order: #36442 (multipath descriptor as one object) → #36443 (reconstruct from expansion) → #36444 (persist multipath info for hardware-signer policy registration).
Silent Payments: #35302 (sending, depends on #35301) unblocks #32966 (receiving); reviewing #32966 first is wasted effort while its base is unmerged.

#35742 and #36420 both fix duplicate-key sanity checking in descriptors (multipath branches vs. x-only comparison in Tapscript). They touch the same validation path and will conflict; review together.
#36070, #35918 and #36143 are all prerequisites for the same multisig setup wizard (#35645); they should be reviewed as one group even though each is individually deferrable.

#30343 removes WalletLogPrintf entirely while #36397 is a scripted diff normalising WalletLogPrintf call sites; whichever lands first largely moots the other — decide the order before reviewing either.
#36339 and #36342 are the same class of defect (crash from out-of-range authenticated RPC arguments in wallet RPCs) and are now banded together; they were previously split across P2/P3.
#36114 supersedes #35358, and #36550 supersedes #36551 — the superseded PRs should not consume separate review attention.
#35492 and #36341 both fix silent success in the bitcoin-wallet tool (dump and create); reviewing them together is efficient.
#35294 and #35760 both change wallet transaction loading/chain-state attachment and will likely conflict; #35294 (crash fix) should go first.
result.notes: The category splits cleanly: a small P1 set of fund-safety/corruption/rescan-correctness fixes, a large P2 band dominated by data-integrity, PSBT/external-signer interoperability, rebroadcast privacy, and the multipath/silent-payments feature chains, then a long P3 tail of narrow bug fixes, optional RPC features and cleanups. The main cross-PR corrections were chain heads lifted to match the work they unblock (#33033, #36443), migration-corruption raised to match other corruption fixes (#34193), and two over-ranked items brought into line with their peers (#34533, #36339, #33043).
